snippet.title: Whatever It Takes | Official trailer
snippet.description:
Whatever It Takes is a hardcore first-person Action RPG set in a grim fantasy world where the forgotten have turned to dust and fallen gods languish in eternal imprisonment. 

Players step into the shoes of Illazar—a fallen deity betrayed by his servants and cast out into the Omnisphere. 

This is a journey of fury, the reclamation of power, and tactile world interaction, where physics and combat mastery outweigh character levels. Will you reclaim your throne from the ashes of betrayal, or will the Omnisphere consume yet another god?

Don't forget to check our Steam page and be ready for the DEMO really soon!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3485200/Whatever_It_Takes/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=wishlist&utm_campaign=trailer

Also visit our website to learn more about our studio: 
https://next-genium.com/en/
